svg.text: In This Town: the whole system
Riders' devices and the kiosk in each car all talk to one Cloudflare Worker on one HTTPS origin, husshusshuss.boston.
match card, where to go, games
rewrites the NFC tag each mission
auth · users · glasses · taps · ride · passport
rate limits per IP · bearer tokens · ErrorRes
every push to main goes live
No native app, no camera, no mic, no GPS, no BLE.
Location only comes from tapping a kiosk's NFC tag.
Ride Mode on is the consent: no accept step per match.
